host_util_incident.label: host CPU at the busiest point

thief_cores.label: cores taken by a process that was not using them before

util_ratio.label: host CPU during the fault, against its own baseline

worst_retrans_pct.label: segments the network had to send again

fork_newcomer_per_s.label: processes per second started by a newly busy program
